methodology.snapshot: Transparent batching clones every queued message immediately. Explicit groups snapshot one graph before returning, preserving aliases across members; already-ready responses may share a reply graph; slow responses stay independent.
methodology.latency: separate group-completion phase after throughput; entire burst RTT, including grouping; quantization retained
methodology.instrumentation: Native send counters installed only in an untimed validation phase; counting-start acknowledgement excluded
methodology.checks: distinct payload objects per member; every result scalar/full text and exact remote echo count
methodology.comparators: cached birpc default 60s timeout; cached Penpal 30s call timeout; CrossBus default guards/30s timeout; startup excluded
methodology.caution: new opt-in experimental bulk API has group-graph semantics, not a drop-in independent-call replacement; no universal rank
